title: Sidney, Spencer and Donne - A Critical Introduction

vibeProfile.oneLine: A critical guide to the Renaissance poetry of Sidney, Spenser and Donne.

summary: A critical introduction to three great poets of the English Renaissance: Philip Sidney, Edmund Spenser and John Donne, whose sonnets, epics and metaphysical lyrics helped shape English poetry. Prepared as a student's companion, it sets the poems in their historical and intellectual context and offers close readings to guide new readers through their difficulty and richness. A useful scholarly doorway into the sixteenth- and seventeenth-century verse that underlies the whole English tradition.
whyReadIt: A clear scholarly doorway into Sidney, Spenser and Donne, three pillars of English Renaissance poetry.

funFacts.text: Donne's 'metaphysical' style, full of daring conceits, was rediscovered and prized in the twentieth century.
